# FL-001 Put a project on NEXUS [한국어](FL-001-put-a-project-on-nexus.ko.md) Goal: An agent sends a project's first snapshot, and the owner finds the project drawn. Serves: REQ-001, REQ-003, REQ-004, REQ-005, REQ-006, REQ-018, REQ-019, REQ-052, REQ-066, REQ-077 ```mermaid flowchart TD A(["Agent pushes a new project
REQ-018"]) B{"Credential valid?
REQ-066"} C{"Owner confirmed the first
send?
REQ-003"} D{"A file looks like a secret
or an email?
REQ-077"} E["Create an empty project
space
REQ-001, REQ-019"] F["Draw the stage diagrams
and item tables
REQ-001, REQ-004, REQ-005, REQ-006"] G["List the project in the
owner's to-do
REQ-052"] R1["Refuse the request
REQ-066"] R2["Reject and ask for the
first-send confirmation
REQ-003"] R3["Refuse the file and name
it in the answer
REQ-077"] Z(["End"]) A e1@--> B B e2@-->|no| R1 B e3@-->|yes| C C e4@-->|no| R2 C e5@-->|yes| D D e6@-->|yes| R3 D e7@-->|no| E E e8@--> F F e9@--> G G e10@--> Z R1 e11@--> Z R2 e12@--> Z R3 e13@--> Z %% legend: below classDef term fill:#e7f5ff,stroke:#1c7ed6,color:#212529 classDef proc fill:#f8f9fa,stroke:#495057,color:#212529 classDef decide fill:#f3f0ff,stroke:#7048e8,color:#212529 classDef gap fill:#f1f3f5,stroke:#adb5bd,stroke-dasharray:2 3,color:#495057 classDef pass stroke:#868e96,stroke-width:1.5px class A,Z term class E,F,G,R1,R2,R3 proc class B,C,D decide class e1,e2,e3,e4,e5,e6,e7,e8,e9,e10,e11,e12,e13 pass ``` | Shape | Means | | --- | --- | | Rounded box | Where the flow starts or ends | | Rectangle | A step | | Diamond | A decision; each branch is labelled | ## Failure paths - Refuse the request (REQ-066) - Reject and ask for the first-send confirmation (REQ-003) - Refuse the file and name it in the answer (REQ-077)

# FL-002 Read a stage from the to-do [한국어](FL-002-read-a-stage-from-the-to-do.ko.md) Goal: The owner opens NEXUS, picks a stage from the to-do and reads its diagram or item table. Serves: REQ-004, REQ-005, REQ-006, REQ-007, REQ-008, REQ-009, REQ-010, REQ-011, REQ-012, REQ-013, REQ-015, REQ-041, REQ-052, REQ-062, REQ-063, REQ-066, REQ-070, REQ-083 ```mermaid flowchart TD A(["Owner opens NEXUS"]) B{"Signed in through the
gate?
REQ-062, REQ-063"} C["Show the owner's to-do
REQ-052"] D["Owner picks a project and
a stage"] E{"Does the stage have a
picture?
REQ-004, REQ-005, REQ-006, REQ-007, REQ-008, REQ-009, REQ-010"} F["Open the diagram with
names, IDs hidden
REQ-004, REQ-005, REQ-011, REQ-070"] G["Open the item table
REQ-006, REQ-011"] H["Mark what changed since
the last confirmation
REQ-041"] I{"What does the owner do?"} J["Store the new position in
NEXUS only
REQ-013, REQ-015"] K["Put the ID and name on the
clipboard
REQ-012"] N["Undo or redo a move
REQ-083"] R1["Not admitted
REQ-062, REQ-066"] Z(["End"]) A e1@--> B B e2@-->|no| R1 B e3@-->|yes| C C e4@--> D D e5@--> E E e6@-->|yes| F E e7@-->|no| G F e8@--> H G e9@--> H H e10@--> I I e11@-->|move an element on a PC| J I e12@-->|copy an element| K I e13@-->|read only| Z J e14@--> Z K e15@--> Z R1 e16@--> Z I e17@-->|undo or redo a move| N N e18@--> Z %% legend: below classDef term fill:#e7f5ff,stroke:#1c7ed6,color:#212529 classDef proc fill:#f8f9fa,stroke:#495057,color:#212529 classDef decide fill:#f3f0ff,stroke:#7048e8,color:#212529 classDef gap fill:#f1f3f5,stroke:#adb5bd,stroke-dasharray:2 3,color:#495057 classDef pass stroke:#868e96,stroke-width:1.5px class A,Z term class C,D,F,G,H,J,K,N,R1 proc class B,E,I decide class e1,e2,e3,e4,e5,e6,e7,e8,e9,e10,e11,e12,e13,e14,e15,e16,e17,e18 pass ``` | Shape | Means | | --- | --- | | Rounded box | Where the flow starts or ends | | Rectangle | A step | | Diamond | A decision; each branch is labelled | ## Failure paths - Not admitted (REQ-062, REQ-066)

# FL-003 Comment and answer an AI proposal [한국어](FL-003-comment-and-answer-an-ai-proposal.ko.md) Goal: The owner comments on a diagram, an agent answers or proposes a change, and the owner accepts or rejects it. Serves: REQ-020, REQ-021, REQ-022, REQ-023, REQ-024, REQ-025, REQ-034, REQ-053, REQ-054, REQ-055, REQ-068 ```mermaid flowchart TD A(["Owner comments on a
diagram, element or row
REQ-020"]) B["Add the comment to the
agent to-do
REQ-053"] C{"Another session holds it?
REQ-054, REQ-055"} D{"Answer or change?"} E["Agent replies in the
thread
REQ-021"] F["Agent posts an AI proposal
laid over the diagram
REQ-022"] G{"Who answers the proposal?"} H{"Accept?"} I["Add the reflection to the
agent to-do
REQ-023"] J["Mark it rejected, thread
stays open
REQ-024"] K["Owner closes the thread
when done
REQ-034"] R1["Refuse the claim
REQ-055"] R2["Not offered on a phone
REQ-068"] R3["Refuse the agent
credential
REQ-025"] Z(["End"]) Y(["Reflect it: FL-005"]) A e1@--> B B e2@-->|agent claims| C C e3@-->|yes| R1 C e4@-->|no| D D e5@-->|answer| E D e6@-->|change| F E e7@--> K F e8@--> G G e9@-->|owner on a PC| H G e10@-->|owner on a phone| R2 G e11@-->|an agent| R3 H e12@-->|yes| I H e13@-->|no| J I e14@--> Y J e15@--> K K e16@--> Z R1 e17@--> Z R2 e18@--> Z R3 e19@--> Z %% legend: below classDef term fill:#e7f5ff,stroke:#1c7ed6,color:#212529 classDef proc fill:#f8f9fa,stroke:#495057,color:#212529 classDef decide fill:#f3f0ff,stroke:#7048e8,color:#212529 classDef gap fill:#f1f3f5,stroke:#adb5bd,stroke-dasharray:2 3,color:#495057 classDef pass stroke:#868e96,stroke-width:1.5px class A,Z,Y term class B,E,F,I,J,K,R1,R2,R3 proc class C,D,G,H decide class e1,e2,e3,e4,e5,e6,e7,e8,e9,e10,e11,e12,e13,e14,e15,e16,e17,e18,e19 pass ``` | Shape | Means | | --- | --- | | Rounded box | Where the flow starts or ends | | Rectangle | A step | | Diamond | A decision; each branch is labelled | ## Failure paths - Refuse the claim (REQ-055) - Not offered on a phone (REQ-068) - Refuse the agent credential (REQ-025)

# FL-004 Edit a diagram directly [한국어](FL-004-edit-a-diagram-directly.ko.md) Goal: The owner renames an element or connects two on a PC, and the edit waits to be reflected into Git. Serves: REQ-026, REQ-027, REQ-028, REQ-053, REQ-068 ```mermaid flowchart TD A(["Owner renames an element
or connects two
REQ-026"]) B{"On a PC?
REQ-068"} C["Record it as an accepted
change set
REQ-026"] D["Show the elements as
waiting for reflection
REQ-027"] E{"Owner cancels before
reflection?
REQ-028"} F["Drop the change set and
redraw without it
REQ-028"] G["Add the reflection to the
agent to-do
REQ-053"] R1["No direct edit on a phone
REQ-068"] Z(["End"]) Y(["Reflect it: FL-005"]) A e1@--> B B e2@-->|no| R1 B e3@-->|yes| C C e4@--> D D e5@--> E E e6@-->|yes| F E e7@-->|no| G F e8@--> Z G e9@--> Y R1 e10@--> Z %% legend: below classDef term fill:#e7f5ff,stroke:#1c7ed6,color:#212529 classDef proc fill:#f8f9fa,stroke:#495057,color:#212529 classDef decide fill:#f3f0ff,stroke:#7048e8,color:#212529 classDef gap fill:#f1f3f5,stroke:#adb5bd,stroke-dasharray:2 3,color:#495057 classDef pass stroke:#868e96,stroke-width:1.5px class A,Z,Y term class C,D,F,G,R1 proc class B,E decide class e1,e2,e3,e4,e5,e6,e7,e8,e9,e10 pass ``` | Shape | Means | | --- | --- | | Rounded box | Where the flow starts or ends | | Rectangle | A step | | Diamond | A decision; each branch is labelled | ## Failure paths - No direct edit on a phone (REQ-068)

# FL-005 Reflect accepted changes into Git [한국어](FL-005-reflect-accepted-changes-into-git.ko.md) Goal: An agent carries a diagram's accepted change sets into the stage document through one pull request. Serves: REQ-001, REQ-029, REQ-030, REQ-031, REQ-032, REQ-053, REQ-054, REQ-056, REQ-057 ```mermaid flowchart TD A(["Agent claims a change set
to reflect
REQ-053, REQ-054"]) B["Agent opens one PR for the
diagram's change sets
REQ-032"] C["Link the reported PR to
its change sets
REQ-029"] D["Keep the claim while the
PR is open
REQ-057"] E{"PR merged?"} F["Draw the snapshot with the
merge commit
REQ-001"] G["Mark the change sets
reflected
REQ-030"] H["Close the threads that
asked for them
REQ-031"] R1["Release the claim after 60
idle minutes
REQ-056"] Z(["End"]) A e1@--> B B e2@--> C C e3@--> D D e4@--> E E e5@-->|yes| F E e6@-->|closed without merge| R1 F e7@--> G G e8@--> H H e9@--> Z R1 e10@--> Z %% legend: below classDef term fill:#e7f5ff,stroke:#1c7ed6,color:#212529 classDef proc fill:#f8f9fa,stroke:#495057,color:#212529 classDef decide fill:#f3f0ff,stroke:#7048e8,color:#212529 classDef gap fill:#f1f3f5,stroke:#adb5bd,stroke-dasharray:2 3,color:#495057 classDef pass stroke:#868e96,stroke-width:1.5px class A,Z term class B,C,D,F,G,H,R1 proc class E decide class e1,e2,e3,e4,e5,e6,e7,e8,e9,e10 pass ``` | Shape | Means | | --- | --- | | Rounded box | Where the flow starts or ends | | Rectangle | A step | | Diamond | A decision; each branch is labelled | ## Failure paths - Release the claim after 60 idle minutes (REQ-056)

# FL-006 Confirm a diagram [한국어](FL-006-confirm-a-diagram.ko.md) Goal: The owner confirms a diagram or an item table on a PC, an agent records it, and the stage passes once all are recorded. Serves: REQ-035, REQ-036, REQ-037, REQ-038, REQ-039, REQ-041, REQ-042, REQ-052, REQ-068 ```mermaid flowchart TD A(["Owner opens a diagram to

REQ-041"] C{"Who asks?"} D{"Confirm or cancel?"} E["Record the confirmation

REQ-035"] F["Add recording it to the
agent to-do
REQ-038"] G["Agent reports the merged
record
REQ-039"] H{"Every diagram and table of
the stage recorded?
REQ-042"} I["Treat the stage checkpoint
as passed
REQ-042"] J["Put it back in the to-do
as not confirmed
REQ-037"] R1["No confirmation on a phone
REQ-068"] R2["Refuse the agent
credential
